title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
abstract: arXiv:2610.13692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. translated_title: 方差缩减策略梯度近乎极小极大最优
translated_abstract: 标准策略梯度（PG）算法由于依赖蒙特卡洛更新而存在高估计方差的问题。虽然离策略方差缩减技术可以缓解这一问题，但要在当前建立最优样本复杂度，要么需要限制性假设（如一致有界的重要性权重），要么需要不实用的二阶操作。在本工作中，我们提出了无环方差缩减策略梯度（LVR-PG），这是一个统一的理论框架，抽象出一类将递归更新与防御性重要性采样相结合的一阶估计器，其中包括已知的估计器如PAGE-PG和STORM-PG。我们证明，在一般参数化策略的弱梯度支配条件下，该算法类能够实现 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 的最后一次迭代全局收敛。我们仅使用纯一阶更新，在最小假设条件下且无需梯度预处理器即可建立这一保证。
tldr: 该论文提出LVR-PG统一理论框架，证明了一类结合递归更新与防御性重要性采样的一阶方差缩减策略梯度算法，在弱梯度支配等最小假设下、无需梯度预处理器，即可达到 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 样本复杂度的近乎极小极大最优最后一次迭代全局收敛。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LVR-PG, a unified theoretical framework proving that a class of first-order variance-reduced policy gradient estimators combining recursive updates with defensive importance sampling achieves nearly minimax-optimal $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence with minimal assumptions, without gradient preconditioners.
